## Highlights
### New
- Crest 0.9 brings Sub-Spaces, which let several Spaces share one set of sign-ins while each keeps its own tabs and look, built-in ad blocking on Mac, iPhone and iPad, and a Chromium engine built from Chromium itself, now at 157. Quick Windows and Peek do more, and Crest can follow the system's light or dark appearance.
### Improved
- On iPhone and iPad, a floating sidebar no longer has an arrow to hide it, on the sidebar or in the side toolbar; scroll or tap the page to put it away.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
